conclusion: No valid FieldType can route Pool.GetChunk or Pool.PutChunk to width 16 or outside the declared cases: accepted getFixedLen returns only VarElemLen, 4, 8, or 40 and Time is eight bytes.
entry_surface: Pool.GetChunk and Pool.PutChunk derive their switch operand exclusively from accepted getFixedLen(FieldType).
proof_steps: Enumerated every accepted getFixedLen switch case at pkg/util/chunk/codec.go and its default.
Confirmed Float maps to 4, integer/double/year/duration/time families map to 8, NewDecimal maps to 40, and every other valid or unknown code maps to VarElemLen.
Confirmed no caller-supplied width bypasses getFixedLen in Pool.GetChunk or Pool.PutChunk.
